create_dataclass_hook_subclass: create a subclass of DataclassHook that implements run and triggers for a custom field lifecycle event
use_hook_event_type_enum: use HookEventType enum values like PRE_INIT or POST_UPDATE to identify which lifecycle phase a hook should fire on
mix_in_dataclass_hook_mixin: mix DataclassHookMixin into a dataclass so that setattr and delattr automatically trigger registered hooks
get_metadata_for_hooks: call DataclassHookMixin.get_metadata with hook instances to produce a metadata dict for a dataclass field
run_hooks_on_field_change: call _run_hooks on a DataclassHookMixin instance to manually execute hooks for a given field and event type
